# Our Platform

Our Platform is a product design and industrial intelligence studio creating web experiences, conversational and voice interfaces, connected workflows, context-aware decisions, MCP servers, agent harnesses, long-term memory, industrial data pipelines, world models, and digital twins.

## Studio FAQ

- /ai-seo-faq — direct answers about the studio, product design, industrial AI systems, delivery, and trust

## AI visibility

We design AI visibility systems that help search engines, answer systems, and agents discover, interpret, cite, and navigate a site. The work includes information architecture, server-rendered answers, entity clarity, structured data, crawler controls, evidence-rich pages, and citation measurement.

## Grounded knowledge systems

Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, semantic search, and semantic layers keep AI answers connected to traceable source meaning.

## Coordinated agent systems

Specialist agents share context, tools, routing, evaluations, and escalation rules when a multi-agent workflow is justified.

## Cloud and networking

AWS architecture across EC2, Fargate, ECR, Lambda, VPC boundaries, delivery pipelines, observability, and secure service-to-service networking.

## Operating model

We connect a physical lifecycle (site, production, quality, logistics, customer) with an AI lifecycle (events, models, agents, decisions, monitoring, feedback). The homepage demonstrates the system through Services, Workflow, Laboratory, About, and Contact subsections.
